versions.changelog: Fix: code quality improvements, resubmit to clear suspicious flag

- No file changes detected in this version.
- Functionality and documentation remain unchanged from the previous release.

- Initial release of cn-emoji-translator.
- Converts text to emoji and emoji to text descriptions.
- Supports both Chinese and English input.
- All processing is done locally; no external API required.
- No external dependencies—uses built-in emoji library or custom mapping.
